reasons: Leading edge reachable before shoreline contact; interception point 12 km W of Pirotan.
Two boom teams and one pollution control vessel can be in position before the ETA.
One aerial sortie and the next Sentinel-1 pass (15 Mar 00:48 UTC) cover the drift window.
Shoreline cleanup ranked for Pirotan and Sikka; Positra mangrove needs a site survey before any method is chosen.
Slick sample and a vessel sample from SAMUDRA PRABHA requested for fingerprinting.
Pirotan Island first (marine national park, earliest ETA), then the Sikka intake.
Draft action plan assembled from the planners above.

alerts.title: Oil predicted at Pirotan Island in 28 h
alerts.explanation: Marine national park: coral reef and mangrove. Earliest shoreline contact of this run.

alerts.title: Sikka desalination intake exposed at +41 h
alerts.explanation: Intake shutdown decision needed before the leading edge passes Vadinar.

alerts.title: Fishing activity inside the drift path
alerts.explanation: Eight small craft reporting within 30 km. Advise through the fisheries department.

mapped.title: Boom Pirotan Island north shore
mapped.detail: 1,200 m shore boom across the reef flat, ahead of the leading edge.

mapped.title: Protect Sikka desalination intake
mapped.detail: Intake boom and standby shutdown plan with the plant operator.

mapped.title: Offshore recovery on the leading edge

mapped.detail: Oil samples at Vadinar SPM berth for fingerprint comparison with the slick.
